judge.name: Contributor 25
judge.method: One independent exhaustive reading of the current content and whole current bar. No handler or screen implementation, test, score, or coverage report was read; no pack was executed. Previous verdicts were context only. This is the newly authorized judgment, not a carry-forward or second judging of applied changes.

barItemsRead: a refusal without a cause the story shows, or the same cause drawn twice; a run of refusals;
a failing repeat of a request that succeeded earlier in the same sitting;
a state switched away and back in one sitting, or returned with no reason the story shows;
a stated cause that never happens, and a promise never kept (a container made "to analyse" data that never runs the analysis, a comparison started and never finished);
a feature tour: one call per option of an endpoint in a row;
a read-back with no need: a list or get of what the story already holds, unless someone who does not hold it reads it;
the wrong actor or credential for an act, a date that contradicts the `wait` steps, a name or id used before it is made or after it is gone;
the wrong era: building on an API the vendor had deprecated by the World's date, or calling one past its documented shutdown;
vendor behaviour the vendor's documentation contradicts;

content that does not bear out the step's name: the code a push carries does not do what the story says it does, an upload carries no bytes of the file it names, a message the vendor never sends in that mode is said to arrive, an attachment lacks what its format requires;

a call through a door the vendor does not document (a path the client builds instead of the one the vendor returned, a read the vendor would refuse for want of a grant the story never gives), even where the twin answers it.

retainedAccountAssessment.reason: The original Orbit Apps organization is created at step 26, renamed Orbit Apps Inc. at step 37, and is never deleted. Kenji alone is removed at step 89; Priya remains its owner. Step 91 creates a distinct pilot under the same product with Priya as owner and captures pilot_org. Step 94 deletes that captured pilot id only, after step 93 obtains a current organizations token. The still-live original organization supplies a known subject for refresh and a parent for member/invitation reads. This follows the product source and the new RECIPE requirement without inventing an enumeration endpoint or emptying the product account.

stepNumbering: The outline has no numbered acts. apply-rulings.ts treats the entire text as frame/part 0; any numeric applySteps would refer to that part. There are no required outline changes.

doubts.reason: The previous application identity behind signing in as a different user is not named. prompt=login is documented and the reauthentication is feasible; the missing context does not establish a contradiction.
The phone existing-session provenance is not described. A valid session for Priya is possible within the stated window, so this remains a story-detail doubt.

doubts.reason: The prose states verification as a client responsibility. The executable life shows key retrieval and token exchanges, which alone do not prove all local cryptographic checks; that is an evidence limit of the life, not an implausible outline action.

barAssessment: Refusals have concrete causes: two different pending device requests and absent Apple configuration.
No prose beat asks for a previously successful request to fail without changed circumstances.
No state is switched away and back merely to visit options; promotion, rename, departure and pilot retirement have forward customer purposes.
The arc carries its stated consequences: Lena invitation is canceled, both devices are approved, Kenji leaves, and the client-declined pilot is deleted while the original account continues.
The product and client variants are the demand own callers and separate occasions, not an unexplained feature tour.
Team views are for the newly added member, invitation views support outstanding-invitation management, and selectors reflect the departure.
The operator, product servers, public client, people, grants and resource audiences are identified. The dated sittings fit the executable waits and documented credential windows.
No documented retirement or incompatible historical release date in the supplied evidence contradicts the chosen dates.
The business and identity acts agree with the pinned product, provider, auth and UI sources; vendor proof mechanisms are stated as outside the served API through explicit World setup.
The described acts match the current life overall, including a distinct pilot, captured separately and owned by Priya; local verification proof remains a stated limitation.

Setup outside the API uses World doors; product organization acts use the published routes and server grant; the public client registration exception is explained. The prose device visit can and should use the existing signed-in laptop session as the life ruling specifies.
assessment: Every outline beat in its unnumbered part 0 was read against all eleven current rejection items, the screen/actor rules, credential and time windows, and RECIPE known-refresh requirement. The story preserves Orbit Apps Inc. and Priya ownership while retiring a distinct pilot with a real prospective-client reason. The operator and product credentials permit the described actions, and the dates are coherent. No established outline defect requires a change. The missing-cookie request is a life-level ruling, not a contradiction in this prose.
